column_description: Unique identifier for each access record.
Reference to the user accessing the system. may be NULL.
Time when the user accessed the system. may be NULL.
Type of access (e.g., view, edit). always exactly one of 'view', 'edit'. may be NULL.
IP address of the user accessing the system. may be NULL.
User agent string of the device used to access the system. may be NULL.
